title: CyberStrikeAI Uses AI Agents in Attacks on Japan
excerpt: Security researchers reveal three cyber attacks against Japanese organizations utilizing artificial intelligence and automated agents.
body_html:
Security researchers have uncovered details regarding three distinct cyber attacks aimed at organizations in Japan, where artificial intelligence played a central role. The operations either placed AI in the driving seat or utilized it to assist human operators during the malicious activities.

Investigators analyzed three exposed server environments that threat actors used to carry out these cyber operations. The findings highlight a novel approach to automated hacking operations, distinguishing these incidents from previously documented threat campaigns.
